label: privacy
heading: What this site collects
intro: This page lists what the site collects and what it does not. The site sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser.

items.text: The host that serves the pages processes standard request logs, which can include your IP address. The site does not read them.

Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits to pages. Cloudflare runs it. It records page load timing, the page path, the referring site, your country, device type, browser and operating system. It sets no cookie and stores nothing in your browser. Cloudflare says it does not track individual visitors across the sites that use it.
A demo loads from Hugging Face only after you click Load live demo. Hugging Face then handles that request under its own terms.
The fit check runs in your browser. The text you paste, and any company or role title you add, is not sent anywhere and is not stored by this site.
The site has no accounts and no form that sends anything to a server.
There are no advertising or marketing scripts. The only third-party script is the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon described above.
